patients.label: 75-year-old woman with rectal adenocarcinoma and perineal skin recurrence at a Lone Star Retractor site

identity_evidence.quote: A 75-year-old woman presented with a left hemicircumferential adenocarcinoma of the rectum

attribution_limitations: The abstract dates the proctectomy "2 years ago" relative to the report, while the case text gives stoma closure 4 months postoperatively and a 14-month follow-up with no stated reference point, and no calendar date.
The authors state the recurrence was most likely caused by seeding of exfoliated tumor cells into retractor-abraded perianal skin; the cause is hedged, not established.

The discussion says recurrence occurred despite "preoperative rectal washing" in this case, whereas the case text describes washing of the anal canal with povidone-iodine at surgery with no timing relative to the operation beyond that sentence.
